findings.why: A pregnancy/lactation safety claim is high-stakes. It matches the product page, but needs product-specific evidence on file before it goes on an ad.
findings.fix: Remove it, or keep only if safety evidence for pregnancy and lactation is confirmed on file for this product.

rule_hit_review.why: Headline names Vitamin B12 with no concentration in that field; advisory only, since the product name carries 03%.
Primary text names Vitamin B12 with no concentration in that field; advisory only.

tone_read: Factual spec-sheet tone with the active, skin type and usage; calm and education-first.
language_read: The spec line states the 03% active correctly and matches page facts. The headline and primary text name Vitamin B12 without its percentage.
